description: This file manages user state in a Redux store, including fetching user data, managing user list, subscriptions, and user preferences, with selectors for accessing user-related state.

classes.name: UsersStatus
classes.description: Type defining the user state including current user, user list, login status, subscriptions, and config.

classes.name: usersSlice
classes.description: Redux slice managing user state with reducers and extra reducers for async actions.

methods.name: fetchMe
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch current user info and config.

methods.name: fetchUserBlockSubscriptions
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch user block subscriptions.

methods.name: setMe
methods.description: Reducer to set current user and login status.

methods.name: setBoardUsers
methods.description: Reducer to set the list of board users.

methods.name: addBoardUsers
methods.description: Reducer to add users to the board user list.

methods.name: removeBoardUsersById
methods.description: Reducer to remove users from the list by IDs.

methods.name: followBlock
methods.description: Reducer to add a block subscription.

methods.name: unfollowBlock
methods.description: Reducer to remove a block subscription.
